integrity: Proof plus two computational checks: direct color refinement over 2730 parameter pairs, and degree-marked unfolded-view equivalence over 160 parameter pairs.
scientific_limitations: Finite undirected initially-uncoloured lollipop graphs only. Counts strict within-graph partition refinements; not a joint-graph iteration number, exact distinguishing-sentence rank, or bound for all unicyclic graphs. Historical originality is provisional. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Exact colour-refinement stabilization rounds for cycle–path lollipop graphs
